Dear Ms. Walsh,
I am writing to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer position at
Acme Corporation, as advertised on your careers page.
My name is Priya Nair, and I currently work as a Backend Engineer
at Helix Solutions in Austin, Texas. Over the past six years, I have
built distributed systems handling millions of requests per day,
with a focus on reliability and performance.
I was referred to this position by Marcus Thompson, who spoke highly
of the engineering culture at Acme. My current manager, Daniel Foster,
can provide a reference. I can be reached at mwebster@example.net
or (512) 555-7733.
I am particularly interested in the work your team is doing on the
DataSync platform. I have experience with similar systems and believe
my background in Go, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL would be a strong fit.
My current address is 88 Riverside Drive, Austin, TX 78701.
I am available to start within 4 weeks of an offer.
Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.
